about: December 2004 street prices (the realism work, phase 4: 2004 street prices and 2004 rares). Each item by its 274 debugname: 'price' is the centre a vendor's ask spreads around (±10 % by the vendor's name, never below high alch: port/BotPrices), 'range' what the source says, 'source' where it comes from. Sources (the research F8 and §2.6): RuneHQ's item database 'Street Price' fields captured 4-18 Dec 2004 (RuneHQ), Sal's Realm player tips (Sal tips) and its November 2004 Q&A (Sal Q&A); rares are estimates (low confidence: PCGamesN's retrospective for partyhats, RuneHQ's crowd-sourced cracker and Easter egg entries, a 2005 forum recollection for santa hats and masks). 'estimate' rows have no period source: the culture track's example lines (written in the period's style, not quotes) or an analogy, for the trade banks' themes. 'rare': sold one at a time, never noted, only by vendors of real levels, never bought back. 'floor': the least a vendor asks where a 274 shop pays more than high alch for one (the review of phase 4). (The variety work, round 2, track W2: the Treasure Trail trims, the god and gilded rune pieces and the Fremennik helms are labelled estimates: no period source gives their prices.)
